title.en: Verbs don't change with the person
title.nb: Verbet er likt for alle personer

en: In the present tense a Norwegian verb has one form for everyone. Most verbs simply end in *-r*: *jeg heter*, *du heter*, *hun heter*, *vi heter*.
So there is nothing like English *I am / you are / she is* to learn. *Å være* (to be) is just *er* for all persons.
nb: I presens har verbet én form for alle. De fleste verb ender bare på *-r*: *jeg heter*, *du heter*, *hun heter*, *vi heter*.
Du trenger altså ikke lære noe som engelsk *I am / you are / she is*. *Å være* er bare *er* for alle personer.
